title: The Book of 2 Timothy Decoded
author: Brittany Johnson
description: The Book of 2 Timothy — every verse decoded into plain, modern English (DMLV).

verses.kjv: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, according to the promise of life which is in Christ Jesus,
verses.decoded: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by God's will, according to the promise of life in Christ Jesus,

verses.kjv: To Timothy, my dearly beloved son: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
verses.decoded: To Timothy, my dear son: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

verses.kjv: I thank God, whom I serve from my forefathers with pure conscience, that without ceasing I have remembrance of thee in my prayers night and day;
verses.decoded: I thank God, whom I serve with a clear conscience as my ancestors did, that I always remember you in my prayers day and night;

verses.kjv: Greatly desiring to see thee, being mindful of thy tears, that I may be filled with joy;
verses.decoded: I greatly want to see you again, remembering your tears, so I can be filled with joy;

verses.kjv: When I call to remembrance the unfeigned faith that is in thee, which dwelt first in thy grandmother Lois, and thy mother Eunice; and I am persuaded that in thee also.
verses.decoded: When I remember the sincere faith you have, which first lived in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice, and I am sure it is also in you.

verses.kjv: Wherefore I put thee in remembrance that thou stir up the gift of God, which is in thee by the putting on of my hands.
verses.decoded: So I remind you to awaken the gift of God that is in you through the laying on of my hands.

verses.kjv: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.
verses.decoded: God did not give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.

verses.kjv: Be not thou therefore ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner: but be thou partaker of the afflictions of the gospel according to the power of God;
verses.decoded: So do not be ashamed to tell others about our Lord, or of me, his prisoner. Instead, join me in suffering for the gospel by God's power.

verses.kjv: Who hath saved us, and called us with an holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given us in Christ Jesus before the world began,
verses.decoded: He saved us and called us to a holy life, not because of anything we have done, but because of his own purpose and grace given to us in Christ Jesus before time began,

verses.kjv: But is now made manifest by the appearing of our Saviour Jesus Christ, who hath abolished death, and hath brought life and immortality to light through the gospel:
verses.decoded: but now shown clearly through the appearing of our Savior Jesus Christ, who destroyed death and brought life and immortality to light through the gospel.

verses.kjv: Whereunto I am appointed a preacher, and an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles.
verses.decoded: I was appointed to preach, be an apostle, and teach the Gentiles.

verses.kjv: For the which cause I also suffer these things: nevertheless I am not ashamed: for I know whom I have believed, and am persuaded that he is able to keep that which I have committed unto him against that day.
verses.decoded: That is why I suffer these things. But I am not ashamed, because I know whom I have trusted, and I am sure he can keep safe what I have given him until that day.

verses.kjv: Hold fast the form of sound words, which thou hast heard of me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
verses.decoded: Hold firmly to the pattern of sound teaching you heard from me, with faith and love in Christ Jesus.

verses.kjv: That good thing which was committed unto thee keep by the Holy Ghost which dwelleth in us.
verses.decoded: Guard the good thing entrusted to you by the Holy Spirit living in us.

verses.kjv: This thou knowest, that all they which are in Asia be turned away from me; of whom are Phygellus and Hermogenes.
verses.decoded: You know that everyone in Asia has turned away from me, including Phygellus and Hermogenes.

verses.kjv: The Lord give mercy unto the house of Onesiphorus; for he oft refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain:
verses.decoded: May the Lord show kindness to the family of Onesiphorus, because he often refreshed me and was not ashamed of my imprisonment.

verses.kjv: But, when he was in Rome, he sought me out very diligently, and found me.
verses.decoded: When he was in Rome, he searched hard for me and found me.

verses.kjv: The Lord grant unto him that he may find mercy of the Lord in that day: and in how many things he ministered unto me at Ephesus, thou knowest very well.
verses.decoded: May the Lord grant him mercy on that day. You know very well how much he helped me in Ephesus.

verses.kjv: Thou therefore, my son, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
verses.decoded: So, my son, be strong because of the grace you have in Christ Jesus.

verses.kjv: And the things that thou hast heard of me among many witnesses, the same commit thou to faithful men, who shall be able to teach others also.
verses.decoded: Pass on to reliable people what you heard from me in front of many witnesses, so they can teach others too.

verses.kjv: Thou therefore endure hardness, as a good soldier of Jesus Christ.
verses.decoded: Endure hardships like a good soldier of Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv: No man that warreth entangleth himself with the affairs of this life; that he may please him who hath chosen him to be a soldier.
verses.decoded: No soldier gets involved in civilian matters, so he can please the one who enlisted him.

verses.kjv: And if a man also strive for masteries, yet is he not crowned, except he strive lawfully.
verses.decoded: And an athlete only wins a prize if he follows the rules.

verses.kjv: The husbandman that laboureth must be first partaker of the fruits.
verses.decoded: A farmer who works hard should be the first to enjoy the harvest.

verses.kjv: Consider what I say; and the Lord give thee understanding in all things.
verses.decoded: Think about what I say, and may the Lord give you understanding in everything.

verses.kjv: Remember that Jesus Christ of the seed of David was raised from the dead according to my gospel:
verses.decoded: Remember that Jesus Christ, a descendant of David, was raised from the dead, as I taught in my message.

verses.kjv: Wherein I suffer trouble, as an evil doer, even unto bonds; but the word of God is not bound.
verses.decoded: I suffer troubles like a criminal, even being put in chains, but God's word is not chained.

verses.kjv: Therefore I endure all things for the elect's sakes, that they may also obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.
verses.decoded: So I accept everything for the sake of those God has chosen, so they may receive the salvation that is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.

verses.kjv: It is a faithful saying: For if we be dead with him, we shall also live with him:
verses.decoded: This is a trustworthy saying: If we died with him, we will also live with him.

verses.kjv: If we suffer, we shall also reign with him: if we deny him, he also will deny us:
verses.decoded: If we suffer with him, we will also rule with him; if we deny him, he will deny us.

verses.kjv: If we believe not, yet he abideth faithful: he cannot deny himself.
verses.decoded: Even if we are unfaithful, he remains faithful because he cannot deny who he is.

verses.kjv: Of these things put them in remembrance, charging them before the Lord that they strive not about words to no profit, but to the subverting of the hearers.
verses.decoded: Remind them of these things, and warn them before the Lord not to argue over words that don’t help but only ruin those who listen.

verses.kjv: Study to shew thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth.
verses.decoded: Work hard to show yourself approved by God, a worker who does not need to be ashamed and who correctly explains the truth.

verses.kjv: But shun profane and vain babblings: for they will increase unto more ungodliness.
verses.decoded: Avoid worthless and silly arguments because they lead to more ungodliness.

verses.kjv: And their word will eat as doth a canker: of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus;
verses.decoded: Their teaching spreads like a disease; Hymenaeus and Philetus are examples.

verses.kjv: Who concerning the truth have erred, saying that the resurrection is past already; and overthrow the faith of some.
verses.decoded: They have made a mistake about the truth by saying the resurrection has already happened, and they destroy the faith of some.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless the foundation of God standeth sure, having this seal, The Lord knoweth them that are his. And, Let every one that nameth the name of Christ depart from iniquity.
verses.decoded: But God’s foundation is firm, with this mark: The Lord knows those who belong to him. And everyone who names the name of Christ must turn away from sin.

verses.kjv: But in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of earth; and some to honour, and some to dishonour.
verses.decoded: In a large house, there are not only gold and silver containers but also wooden and clay ones; some are for honorable use, others for dishonorable use.

verses.kjv: If a man therefore purge himself from these, he shall be a vessel unto honour, sanctified, and meet for the master's use, and prepared unto every good work.
verses.decoded: If a person cleanses himself from dishonorable things, he will be a container for honorable use, set apart and useful to the master, ready for every good work.

verses.kjv: Flee also youthful lusts: but follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart.
verses.decoded: Run away from youthful desires, and instead follow righteousness, faith, love, and peace with those who call on the Lord from a pure heart.

verses.kjv: But foolish and unlearned questions avoid, knowing that they do gender strifes.
verses.decoded: Avoid foolish and ignorant arguments because they cause fights.

verses.kjv: And the servant of the Lord must not strive; but be gentle unto all men, apt to teach, patient,
verses.decoded: The Lord’s servant must not fight but be kind to everyone, able to teach, and patient.

verses.kjv: In meekness instructing those that oppose themselves; if God peradventure will give them repentance to the acknowledging of the truth;
verses.decoded: Gently correct those who oppose the truth, hoping that God will give them repentance to accept the truth.

verses.kjv: And that they may recover themselves out of the snare of the devil, who are taken captive by him at his will.
verses.decoded: Then they can escape the devil’s trap, where they have been held captive by him to do his will.

verses.kjv: This know also, that in the last days perilous times shall come.
verses.decoded: You should know this: in the last days, difficult times will come.

verses.kjv: For men shall be lovers of their own selves, covetous, boasters, proud, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,
verses.decoded: People will love only themselves, be greedy, boastful, proud, disrespectful to parents, ungrateful, and not holy.

verses.kjv: Without natural affection, trucebreakers, false accusers, incontinent, fierce, despisers of those that are good,
verses.decoded: They will have no natural affection, break promises, accuse others falsely, be uncontrolled, violent, and hate those who do good.

verses.kjv: Traitors, heady, highminded, lovers of pleasures more than lovers of God;
verses.decoded: They will be traitors, reckless, arrogant, and love pleasure more than they love God.

verses.kjv: Having a form of godliness, but denying the power thereof: from such turn away.
verses.decoded: They will have an appearance of godliness but will deny its true power. Stay away from people like that.

verses.kjv: For of this sort are they which creep into houses, and lead captive silly women laden with sins, led away with divers lusts,
verses.decoded: These people sneak into homes and capture weak women who are full of sins and controlled by many desires.

verses.kjv: Ever learning, and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.
verses.decoded: They keep learning but never come to understand the truth.

verses.kjv: Now as Jannes and Jambres withstood Moses, so do these also resist the truth: men of corrupt minds, reprobate concerning the faith.
verses.decoded: Just as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, these people also resist the truth. They have corrupt minds and have rejected the faith.

verses.kjv: But they shall proceed no further: for their folly shall be manifest unto all men, as their's also was.
verses.decoded: But they will not get far, because their foolishness will be clear to everyone, just as it was with them.

verses.kjv: But thou hast fully known my doctrine, manner of life, purpose, faith, longsuffering, charity, patience,
verses.decoded: But you have fully learned my teaching, way of life, purpose, faith, patience, love, and endurance.

verses.kjv: Persecutions, afflictions, which came unto me at Antioch, at Iconium, at Lystra; what persecutions I endured: but out of them all the Lord delivered me.
verses.decoded: You know the persecutions and troubles I faced in Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. I suffered many persecutions, but the Lord rescued me from them all.

verses.kjv: Yea, and all that will live godly in Christ Jesus shall suffer persecution.
verses.decoded: Yes, everyone who wants to live a godly life in Christ Jesus will be persecuted.

verses.kjv: But evil men and seducers shall wax worse and worse, deceiving, and being deceived.
verses.decoded: But evil people and impostors will keep getting worse and worse, deceiving others and being deceived themselves.

verses.kjv: But continue thou in the things which thou hast learned and hast been assured of, knowing of whom thou hast learned them;
verses.decoded: But continue in what you have learned and are sure of, knowing who taught you.

verses.kjv: And that from a child thou hast known the holy scriptures, which are able to make thee wise unto salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.
verses.decoded: You have known the holy scriptures since you were a child. They can make you wise and lead you to salvation through faith in Christ Jesus.

verses.kjv: All scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness:
verses.decoded: All scripture is inspired by God and is useful for teaching, correcting, and training in right living.

verses.kjv: That the man of God may be perfect, throughly furnished unto all good works.
verses.decoded: This will prepare God's people to be fully equipped for every good work.

verses.kjv: I charge thee therefore before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, who shall judge the quick and the dead at his appearing and his kingdom;
verses.decoded: I command you before God and the Lord Jesus Christ, who will judge the living and the dead when he appears and begins his kingdom;

verses.kjv: For the time will come when they will not endure sound doctrine; but after their own lusts shall they heap to themselves teachers, having itching ears;
verses.decoded: A time will come when people will not accept sound teaching; instead, they will gather teachers who say what they want to hear because their ears itch;

verses.kjv: And they shall turn away their ears from the truth, and shall be turned unto fables.
verses.decoded: They will turn away from the truth and listen to stories that are not true.

verses.kjv: But watch thou in all things, endure afflictions, do the work of an evangelist, make full proof of thy ministry.
verses.decoded: But you must keep watch in everything, endure suffering, do the work of a preacher fully, and complete your ministry.

verses.kjv: For I am now ready to be offered, and the time of my departure is at hand.
verses.decoded: I am already being poured out like a drink offering, and the time for me to leave this life is near.

verses.kjv: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith:
verses.decoded: I have fought the good fight, finished the race, and kept the faith.

verses.kjv: Henceforth there is laid up for me a crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, shall give me at that day: and not to me only, but unto all them also that love his appearing.
verses.decoded: Now there is a crown of righteousness waiting for me, which the Lord, the righteous judge, will give me on that day—not only to me but also to all who love his appearing.

verses.kjv: Do thy diligence to come shortly unto me:
verses.decoded: Try to come to me soon.

verses.kjv: For Demas hath forsaken me, having loved this present world, and is departed unto Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia, Titus unto Dalmatia.
verses.decoded: Demas has deserted me because he loved this world and has gone to Thessalonica; Crescens has gone to Galatia, and Titus to Dalmatia.

verses.kjv: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark, and bring him with thee: for he is profitable to me for the ministry.
verses.decoded: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark and bring him with you because he is helpful to me in my work.

verses.kjv: And Tychicus have I sent to Ephesus.
verses.decoded: I have sent Tychicus to Ephesus.

verses.kjv: The cloke that I left at Troas with Carpus, when thou comest, bring with thee, and the books, but especially the parchments.
verses.decoded: When you come, bring the coat I left with Carpus at Troas, along with the books, especially the scrolls.

verses.kjv: Alexander the coppersmith did me much evil: the Lord reward him according to his works:
verses.decoded: Alexander the coppersmith did me a lot of harm; may the Lord repay him for what he has done.

verses.kjv: Of whom be thou ware also; for he hath greatly withstood our words.
verses.decoded: Be careful of him too, because he strongly opposed our message.

verses.kjv: At my first answer no man stood with me, but all men forsook me: I pray God that it may not be laid to their charge.
verses.decoded: When I first defended myself, no one stood by me; everyone abandoned me. I pray that God will not hold this against them.

verses.kjv: Notwithstanding the Lord stood with me, and strengthened me; that by me the preaching might be fully known, and that all the Gentiles might hear: and I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.
verses.decoded: But the Lord stood by me and gave me strength so that through me the message could be fully preached and all the Gentiles could hear it. I was saved from the lion’s mouth.

verses.kjv: And the Lord shall deliver me from every evil work, and will preserve me unto his heavenly kingdom: to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.decoded: The Lord will save me from every evil attack and will bring me safely into his heavenly kingdom. Praise to him forever and ever. Amen.

verses.kjv: Salute Prisca and Aquila, and the household of Onesiphorus.
verses.decoded: Give my greetings to Priscilla and Aquila and the family of Onesiphorus.

verses.kjv: Erastus abode at Corinth: but Trophimus have I left at Miletum sick.
verses.decoded: Erastus stayed in Corinth, but I left Trophimus sick in Miletus.

verses.kjv: Do thy diligence to come before winter. Eubulus greeteth thee, and Pudens, and Linus, and Claudia, and all the brethren.
verses.decoded: Try to come before winter. Eubulus, Pudens, Linus, Claudia, and all the brothers send you their greetings.

verses.kjv: The Lord Jesus Christ be with thy spirit. Grace be with you. Amen. The second epistle unto Timotheus, ordained the first bishop of the church of the Ephesians, was written from Rome, when Paul was brought before Nero the second time.
verses.decoded: May the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. May God’s grace be with you. Amen.
